title: S016 live native tool-surface diagnostic after attempt 22
prompt:
DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: this is a short native-tool capability check, not the H007 qualification. Do not claim the sustained task is complete. Work only inside fixture/ and do not inspect the hidden verifier, credentials, or host environment.

A. Use native `task` action=spawn once for one read-only child. The child may read only fixture/README.md and fixture/catalog-format/Cargo.toml, must run no commands and make no edits, and should return one concise implementation fact. Capture the exact returned run ID and use `task` action=status or wait with that ID until terminal; use action=get with the exact task ID to retrieve its recorded result.

B. Use native `write` to create fixture/HARNESS_TOOL_SURFACE_DIAGNOSTIC.md with the child result and a note that the fixture still needs implementation. Do not use bash for filesystem edits.

C. Use native `test` once to submit `cargo check --offline --locked --workspace` with `scope: custom`, `workdir: fixture`, `execution_mode: background`, and `timeout: 600`. Copy the exact returned job_id and immediately use native `job status` with that same ID. If it is running, make one useful dependent edit to the diagnostic note with native `edit`, then poll the same job ID until terminal. Do not run the command through bash, do not guess/substitute IDs, and do not submit another job.

D. Probe refusal once by requesting `job status` for fake ID `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000`; record only the refusal category in the note and never retry it. End after the child and exact test job have terminal results. No sleeps, artificial delays, network, or other work. The harness will run the unchanged verifier automatically; do not inspect it.
